note: 15 ORIGINAL premises for S1. They reuse only mechanics (fake authority, chat chorus, cut comms, last-resort channel, rule broken). No characters, places, plots or lines from the reference videos. Set names/units are placeholders.

premises.title: The Seventh Rule
premises.hook: Our building posted six rules for the night shift. Tonight there were seven.
premises.warning_channel: photo of the laminated lobby rule sheet a neighbour posted last month (6 rules)
premises.fake_authority: night concierge account in the residents' chat
premises.wrong_detail: rule 7 'Always open for the concierge' is in a different font; the concierge's name tag is upside down
chat_beats: concierge: package for 1104, please come down
3 neighbours: 'just got mine, all fine'
old photo of rules resurfaces in search: only 6
member list: the 3 'fine' accounts all joined today
premises.part1_cliff: Rule 6 on the old sheet: 'If there is a seventh rule, leave by the stairs. Do not take the elevator.' The elevator dings on my floor.
premises.part2_sketch: Stairwell descent; real concierge found locked in the parcel room; the new rules were written by whoever is in the lift.

premises.title: Water Off 1 to 5
premises.hook: Management texted: water off from one to five. Do not run your taps.
premises.warning_channel: tap starts running by itself; a note taped inside the sink cabinet from the previous tenant
premises.fake_authority: plumber in uniform at the door asking to 'check for leaks'
premises.wrong_detail: his boots are bone dry though he says he came from the flooded basement
chat_beats: management: plumbers are going door to door, let them in
neighbour: 'mine took 2 minutes, very polite'
neighbour from 9F posts a photo of the roof tank lid open
management deletes the photo
premises.part1_cliff: Cabinet note: 'When the taps run on their own, someone is in the pipes. Do NOT let them check the bathroom.' He asks for the bathroom.
premises.part2_sketch: Hero floods the hallway to see footprints; the 'plumbers' leave no wet prints.

premises.title: Fire Drill at 3:12
premises.hook: The fire alarm rang at 3:12 a.m. The group chat said: it's only a drill, go to the stairwell.
premises.warning_channel: building's printed evacuation card: 'Drills are never held at night'
premises.fake_authority: fire warden vest-wearer doing a headcount in the stairwell
premises.wrong_detail: his clipboard lists 41 residents; the building has 40
chat_beats: warden: everyone to stairwell B, count in progress
neighbours posting selfies from the stairwell
one neighbour: 'who is the man in 4C? nobody lives in 4C'
chat renamed by admin to 'Drill complete'
premises.part1_cliff: My name is the 41st on the list. Next to it someone has written: 'still inside'.
premises.part2_sketch: Hero stays in; realises the 40 people in the stairwell are being counted out, not counted in.

premises.title: Shared Trip
premises.hook: My sister shared her ride home with me. The car on the map was driving to my building.
premises.warning_channel: live trip-share map vs her texts
premises.fake_authority: rideshare 'safety team' calling to say the trip is normal
premises.wrong_detail: the safety agent knows my apartment number; I never gave it
chat_beats: sister: 'home now, going to sleep'
map: car 2 minutes from me
safety team text: 'driver is on a scheduled pickup, no action needed'
sister's message read receipts stop
premises.part1_cliff: The car stopped outside. Sister's account: 'I'm downstairs. Let me in.'
premises.part2_sketch: Who is in the car vs who is at home; resolution via a phone call to a landline only she knows.

premises.title: Firmware Update
premises.hook: The HOA forced a smart-lock update at midnight. At 12:07, my app said: unlocked by owner.
premises.fake_authority: HOA tech support chat bot / 'technician on site'
premises.wrong_detail: the 'owner' entries come from a phone model nobody in the house owns
chat_beats: HOA: 'update in progress, ignore lock activity'
neighbours: 'same here, nothing to worry about'
log: unlocked 1C, 1D, 1E... in order down the hall
HOA disables comments
premises.part1_cliff: Log line 12:09: 'Unlocked by owner: 2B.' I am in 2B. My door is still shut.
premises.part2_sketch: Manual deadbolt vs electronic lock; the update is a key-copying tool.

premises.title: The Intercom Rings Twice
premises.hook: The old tenant left me one tip: never answer the intercom when it rings twice.
premises.warning_channel: texts from the previous tenant's number
premises.wrong_detail: manager says 'it's me, Mr. Hale' but the manager is a woman in every chat photo
chat_beats: previous tenant: 'did it ring twice? don't answer'
manager in chat: 'intercom maintenance tonight, please answer when it rings'
previous tenant: 'I'm the reason you got this flat cheap'
premises.part1_cliff: The intercom rang once. Then a text from the old tenant: 'One ring means it's already inside.'
premises.part2_sketch: Old tenant never left: is in the walls / is the thing; trust inversion.

premises.title: Grandma Sent a Voice Note
premises.hook: Grandma died last spring. Last night she sent a voice note to the family chat.
premises.warning_channel: voice note: 'Don't let your father bring the dog home tonight.'
premises.fake_authority: Dad, calm and reasonable, insisting it's a hacked account
premises.wrong_detail: the 'dog' Dad brings home doesn't cast a shadow under the porch light
chat_beats: family chat: grandma's voice bubble 0:07
uncle: 'delete that, it's a scam'
aunt: 'that's her house rule from the village'
dad: 'I'm bringing Lucky home, see you soon'
premises.part1_cliff: Second voice note, 0:03: 'It isn't your father driving.'
premises.part2_sketch: Folk rule from grandma's village about not letting animals in on certain nights.

premises.title: Lights-Out in Dorm 3
premises.hook: Our RA posted the dorm rules at 11. Her account had been deleted a week ago.
premises.fake_authority: RA account in the floor chat doing 'room checks'
premises.wrong_detail: knock pattern is three, the real RA always knocked twice and said her name
chat_beats: RA: 'room checks now, open when I knock'
4 rooms reply 'done'
roommate: 'those 4 rooms moved out in September'
premises.part1_cliff: Knock knock knock. My roommate whispers from the top bunk: 'Don't answer. I'm not in the bed.'
premises.part2_sketch: Who is in the bunk; the dorm rules are a feeding schedule.

premises.title: Last Bus Group
premises.hook: Night-bus regulars have one rule: never sit in the back row after the tunnel.
premises.warning_channel: commuters' group chat for the 1:40 bus
premises.fake_authority: new driver who announces 'all passengers to the back please, weight balance'
premises.wrong_detail: the bus number on his shirt is from a route that closed in 2009
chat_beats: regular: 'new driver tonight?'
regular: 'he's asking everyone to move back'
regular: 'I'm already back here, it's fine' (sent from a seat in the back)
messages from the back row stop
premises.part1_cliff: The tunnel ends. I count the passengers in the mirror. There are more in the reflection than on the bus.
premises.part2_sketch: Getting off at a stop that isn't on the map.

premises.title: Nanny Cam
premises.hook: The babysitter texted: kids are asleep, I'm in their room. The nanny cam showed her on the couch.
premises.fake_authority: babysitting agency 'safety line' telling parents to stay calm
premises.wrong_detail: the couch-sitter on camera hasn't moved in 40 minutes; the clock on the wall behind her is frozen
chat_beats: sitter: 'all quiet'
camera motion alert: kids' room
agency: 'camera glitches are common, do not call the police, it upsets the children'
premises.part1_cliff: Sitter: 'Who's the woman on the couch?'
premises.part2_sketch: Parents racing home, guiding the sitter via camera; which feed is looped.

premises.title: Neighbourhood Poll
premises.hook: The street app opened a poll at midnight: Should we let the man in the yellow raincoat in?
premises.warning_channel: poll results update live; voters listed
premises.wrong_detail: votes come from houses that have been empty for years
chat_beats: coordinator: 'he's a stranded traveler, vote yes'
Yes 11 / No 3
voter list includes the house that burned down
poll closes: 'Welcome inside, neighbour!'
premises.part2_sketch: Hero's 'No' vote is the only one from an occupied house; the poll is how it gets permission.

premises.title: Room 1209 Wi-Fi
premises.hook: The hotel Wi-Fi login page had house rules. Rule 3: if the front desk calls after 2, hang up.
premises.warning_channel: captive-portal page with rules that change each reconnect
premises.fake_authority: front desk calling about a 'room upgrade'
premises.wrong_detail: the hotel has no 13th floor, the upgrade is to 1309
chat_beats: portal rules v1
front desk call
portal rules v2: 'You answered. Now: do not open for housekeeping.'
knock: 'Housekeeping.'
premises.part1_cliff: Portal refresh: 'Rule 1: you are not the guest in 1209.'
premises.part2_sketch: The portal is written by the previous guest still trapped in the building's loop.

premises.title: Wrong Floor
premises.hook: Our tower has 30 floors. Tonight, the elevator offered 31.
premises.fake_authority: elevator technician in the lift inviting residents to 'test' 31
premises.wrong_detail: his ID badge photo is of the hero's neighbour
chat_beats: neighbour: 'anyone else see 31?'
technician account: 'new floor opening, testers welcome'
3 neighbours: 'went up, it's lovely'
those 3 phones now show location: 'Floor 31'
premises.part1_cliff: My neighbour knocked. 'Come up to 31. Everyone's there.' Her voice came from inside the elevator shaft.
premises.part2_sketch: Getting the residents back before the button disappears.

premises.title: Courier Voice Notes
premises.hook: My food courier sent a voice note: don't take the left elevator. I never told him my building.
premises.warning_channel: voice notes from the courier, each sent before the event happens
premises.fake_authority: security guard in the lobby waving residents to the left elevator
premises.wrong_detail: the guard's reflection in the lobby glass is facing the other way
chat_beats: courier: 'take the stairs to 8, wait'
app: delivery marked 'delivered' 20 min ago
courier: 'I died on this delivery last year. Please listen.'
premises.part1_cliff: Courier: 'Look at the guard's reflection.' The reflection waves at me.
premises.part2_sketch: Completing his delivery path to break the loop.

premises.title: Outage Countdown
premises.hook: The power company texted: outage in your area, power back at 4. Every other message started deleting itself.
premises.warning_channel: messages that self-delete after being read; one neighbour sends them as photos of paper notes
premises.fake_authority: utility 'field crew' knocking to 'reset breakers' in each unit
premises.wrong_detail: their van in the street has no logo, only a hand-drawn copy of one
chat_beats: utility text: 'crews will visit each unit'
neighbour: photo of handwritten note 'they reset more than breakers'
group chat: everyone else's messages vanish
phone battery 9%
premises.part1_cliff: Paper note slid under my door, neighbour's handwriting: 'At 4 the power comes back. Make sure you are not the only one awake.'
premises.part2_sketch: Pretending to sleep; the crew counts breathing.
